Usage: seerapi [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...

  SeerAPI command-line client.

Options:
  --hostname TEXT      API hostname.  [default: api.seerapi.com]
  --scheme TEXT        API URL scheme.  [default: https]
  --version-path TEXT  API version path segment.  [default: v1]
  --pretty             Pretty-print JSON output.
  -V, --version        Show the version and exit.
  -h, --help           Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  describe     Show JSON Schema and supported operations for a resource.
  get          Get a single resource by ID.
  get-by-name  Get resources by name (NamedModel resources only).
  list         List resources with single-page pagination.
  resources    List all available API resources.
  skill        Show and install the bundled agent skill.
Usage: seerapi list [OPTIONS] RESOURCE

  List resources with single-page pagination.

Options:
  --name TEXT             Search by name substring (named resources only).
  --offset INTEGER        [default: 0]
  --limit INTEGER         [default: 20]
  --expand / --no-expand  Return full resource objects in list results.
                          [default: expand]
  --fields TEXT           Comma-separated fields to include for each result
                          item.
  -h, --help              Show this message and exit.
